prediction.mainSelectionRule: Exhaustive maximum of mean prior frequency across the 10 triples contained in each 5-number combination, using only draws available before target draw.
prediction.keyRule: Ancillary only: modal key among the last 200 archived draws. Key is NOT part of the triple-commonness hypothesis.

note: One prospective result cannot promote a strategy. Aggregate gates in the frozen pre-registration remain binding.
